pitch.interpretation: Pitch ranges describe acoustic F0 only and do not determine speaker gender.

snr.calculation: Per-frame 10*log10(clean power / (noisy-clean) power), 20 ms windows with 10 ms hop; median over active frames, then median across examples.
snr.length_handling: Clean/noisy pairs are truncated to the shorter decoded length.
snr.active_frame_threshold: clean RMS >= max(1e-5, 1% of the clip's peak frame RMS)
